versions.changelog:
- Added a section to promote the Lead Pilot Premium upgrade, including a feature list and purchase link.
- No changes made to core functionality or instructions.
- Documentation update only; no code or feature changes.

Initial release of Real Estate Lead Pilot (ThumbGate Grounded):

- Qualifies real estate leads using a structured 4-point framework (Budget, Location, Timeline, Motivation).
- Prevents misinformation by grounding all property details via ThumbGate rules; no MLS hallucinations.
- Books appointments directly into connected calendars after successful lead qualification.
- Syncs all lead data and behavioral scores with popular CRMs (Follow Up Boss, LionDesk, Sheets).
- Detects negotiation or user frustration and alerts for seamless human takeover.
